verbs.name: edit.remove_marker
verbs.description: Remove a marker by id (two-segment name).

include_inverse.description: Deprecated compatibility option. Accepted for v0.6 callers but new operations use recompute-by-replay and have no inverse payload to include.

verbs.name: edit.seek_marker
verbs.description: JUMP-TO navigation over markers/bookmarks: given a reference position `from_ms`, return the NEXT or PREV marker (or first/last, or one by id). A pure READ — no mutation; the caller (a UI key-binding or an agent) then moves the playhead to the returned `at_ms` (e.g. via ui.playhead). Markers are the named bookmarks set by edit.add_marker; BEAT markers (beat:N, surfaced by audio.add_music from the perception beat grid) are included, so this also steps through the beat grid. Returns marker:null when there is none in that direction (or no markers at all).

from_ms.description: Reference position; next/prev are computed relative to this (default 0).

direction.description: Which marker to jump to (default next). Ignored when `id` is given.

id.description: Jump to this exact marker id (overrides direction).

verbs.result: {marker: {id, at_ms, label, note} | null, index?, total}

verbs.name: edit.move_marker
verbs.description: Reposition an existing marker to a new timeline time. ONE op, the marker id is PRESERVED — a remove + re-add would mint a new id and break any reference to the marker. Use edit.add_marker / edit.remove_marker to create/destroy markers.

include_inverse.description: Deprecated compatibility option. Accepted for v0.6 callers but new operations use recompute-by-replay and have no inverse payload to include.

verbs.name: edit.update_marker
verbs.description: Re-label, re-color, and/or edit the note on an existing marker (core editing). ONE op, the marker id AND position are PRESERVED. label/color/note are independent — pass any one or combination; color:"none" clears back to the default look, and a blank note clears the note. Valid colors: red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink. SYSTEM markers are refused (the beat grid 'beat' and 'capture:'-prefixed markers are machine-managed and matched by label). Use edit.move_marker to reposition, edit.add_marker/edit.remove_marker to create/destroy.

include_inverse.description: Deprecated compatibility option. Accepted for v0.6 callers but new operations use recompute-by-replay and have no inverse payload to include.

verbs.result: {marker_id, old_label, label, old_color, color, old_note, note}; one op appended

verbs.name: edit.restore
verbs.description: Undo a previous op by appending a NEW op referencing the old one; the log is immutable. Also the review-rail 'reject' action. mode:"tip" (DEFAULT) recomputes the pre-target journal prefix and is TIP-ONLY: a deeper target returns a guardrail error naming the later ops that would be discarded. mode:"rebase" is SELECTIVE non-tip undo: it reproduces the timeline as if the op never happened while KEEPING the later ops (id-pinned skip-replay), and is refused with a guardrail error naming the dependents if any later op references an id the target created. Full rollback to a point = project.revert{to}.

mode.description: tip (default): recompute the LATEST timeline op's pre-target journal prefix. rebase: selectively undo THIS op, keeping later ops (refused if a later op depends on it).

include_inverse.description: Deprecated compatibility option. Accepted for v0.6 callers but new operations use recompute-by-replay and have no inverse payload to include.

verbs.result: {restored_op_id, op_ids} for a tip restore; {restored_op_id, op_ids, mode:"rebase", rebased_over:[later op ids]} for a rebase
